docs.title: Cayetano Soneira Landín
docs.text:
Predoctoral researcher in Nuclear and Particle Physics at the Complutense University of Madrid.

My work focuses on radiation-detector instrumentation, Resistive Plate Chambers for cosmic-ray monitoring, scintillation detectors, and in-beam PET for proton therapy.

docs.title: Summary
docs.text: Predoctoral researcher in Nuclear and Particle Physics focused on radiation detector instrumentation, cosmic-ray monitoring, and medical imaging. Current work includes scintillation detectors, RPC-based telescopes, and in-beam PET methods for proton therapy.

docs.title: Research Areas
docs.text:
• Radiation detector instrumentation (scintillators, RPCs)
  • Cosmic-ray monitoring and space weather applications
  • Medical imaging and in-beam PET for proton therapy

  • Design and performance studies of Resistive Plate Chambers for cosmic-ray monitoring

docs.title: About
docs.text:
Predoctoral researcher at the Complutense University of Madrid working in Nuclear and Particle Physics, with applications in medical imaging and cosmic-ray instrumentation.

Research topics include electronic instrumentation, Resistive Plate Chambers, scintillation detectors, and in-beam PET for proton therapy.
